description: Present a gift to another Sim via their pie menu's Give Gift / Gift entry. Prerequisite: target exposes a gift entry on the live pie menu (typically gated on having an appropriate inventory item; in TSO classic, gifts draw from the giver's inventory). Effect: queues the resolved interaction; on completion the gift object transfers from your inventory to the target and shifts their relationship to you upward on friendship (and sometimes romance if the gift is themed). Cost: in-sim minutes; queue slot; and the inventory item consumed by the gift — non-recoverable without an explicit return/take-back from the recipient.
